en: Vintage multi-view postcard printed in sepia tones. The upper left image shows a rural landscape with a dirt path, fields, and farmhouses under the caption "Total." The lower left image, captioned "Strassenpartie.", shows a village street with people walking, traditional houses, and a church tower in the background. The right-hand image, captioned "Gasthaus u. Bierbrauerei zum Lamm.", depicts a large traditional inn and brewery building with many windows; several people stand and sit in front. Decorative floral elements surround the central text "Gruss aus Berghülen." The publisher information appears along the bottom edge.
